```{r}
count_above <- function(x, c){
  count <- 0
for(i in 1:length(x)){
  if(i > c){
    count <- count + 1
  }
}
  return(count)
}

head(iris$Sepal.Length)
```

```{r}
count_above(iris$Sepal.Length, 6)
```
